remarks: Waterfront Luxury in the Heart of Rowayton. A rare opportunity to own one of the most refined riverfront residences, thoughtfully designed for elegance and ease of living. This single-level 3 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom condominium evokes the timeless beauty of a New England boathouse, elevated with modern sophistication. Enjoy the perfect blend of indoor-outdoor living, and the essence of relaxed, coastal vibes. Walls of folding glass frame sweeping water views, while the west-facing terrace opens to golden sunsets over the Five Mile River. Special features include 9ft ceilings, wide plank flooring, superb millwork, triple glazed windows, and 3 en suite bedrooms. The Primary has an oversized spa like marble bathroom adjacent to a large walk in closet. Every detail reflects uncompromising quality and craftsmanship, offering a truly luxurious living experience. Residents may enjoy private marina access and peace of mind with lock-and-leave convenience. This spectacular location is within steps of Rowayton's restaurants, shops, markets, beaches, and Pinkney Park with it's Farmer's Market, Shakespeare on the Sound and community music and events.
